name: Fatemeh Fannizadeh
description: Fatemeh is a Swiss-qualified lawyer and digital-rights researcher working at the intersection of blockchain regulation, privacy, decentralized governance, and internet infrastructure. She advises blockchain projects on legal and protocol design, and explores how access, power, and technical architecture shape who can meaningfully participate in decentralized systems. She is a member of the Ethereum Foundation’s Silviculture Society and the Laboratory for Universal Basic Broadband Access.
